1747: Four-corner carrier and explicit full-mean consumer. This new calculation supplies an actual local-gauge/path mechanism and a typed estimate for BOTH fixed source means. It does not alter the frozen1746 input or its adverse report, restart that review, select a new physical mean, or certify the whole physical domain. The old two-adjacent-block coarse-loop proof is not used.

ACTUAL CARRIER. Let m=(L-1)/2, L odd, and consider a coarse mu-nu plaquette with four centers y, y+L e_mu, y+L e_nu, y+L(e_mu+e_nu), in ORIGINAL fine steps. Let C4 be the fine rectangular union of these FOUR full unit blocks. Its coordinate widths are 2L in mu,nu and L in other directions. Require an embedded compatible local lift; a torus-wrapped nominal box is not covered. Every original shortest contour G(center,x) of CMP1090.3 stays in its block. For a coarse edge, the translated straight path [x,x'] and the two endpoint contour families stay in its pair of adjacent blocks, a subset of C4. The four coarse edges together require C4, not a single pair. All fine plaquettes in this box are to be controlled by ONE actual source minimum U1,D on a good test cube D' with its original enlarged halo. Distinct edgewise local minima are not glued together.

CANONICAL LOCAL GAUGE AND SURFACES. Let r be the lower corner of the rectangular fine-vertex box C4. Let T_v be the positive monotone coordinate-order path from r to a vertex v. Its length is at most2dL. For a positive fine edge e=(u,u+e_i), both T_u followed by e and T_(u+e_i) are monotone positive paths with the same displacement and length at most2dL+1. Transform one into the other by adjacent swaps of coordinate steps, using at most A_edge=(2dL+1)^2 swaps. Each swap sweeps one fine plaquette and every intermediate path is in the rectangle [r,u+e_i], hence in C4. This gives an exact nonabelian product of conjugated plaquette holonomies, without commuting group matrices. For real unitary U with sup_(p in C4)|U(dp)-I|<=epsilon_f, the local gauge g(v)=U(T_v) therefore gives

 |U_g(e)-I|<=A_edge epsilon_f.                         (1)

Reverse orientations preserve this bound. The path-word argument is independent of the old1737 A_box. Gauge covariance is used only to estimate the SAME physical mean: this local gauge is not imposed on the original measure or fixed exterior.

FULL MEAN, WITH NO REUSED C_A. Put B_len=dL A_edge. An endpoint contour of0.3 has at most dL edges, so |U_g(G)-I|<=B_len epsilon_f. A straight translated or reference coarse edge path has L edges and satisfies the same weaker bound. For the group mean M in0.5-0.11, its first-order expansion0.8 and analyticity imply the following for the fixed actual mean: there exists a positive real chart radius a_M such that

 max_j |P_j-I|<a_M => |M({P_j})-I|<=2 max_j|P_j-I|.    (2)

Indeed the first derivative at the diagonal identity is the convex arithmetic average, whose max-input operator norm is <=1; the analytic remainder is O(b^2) for b=max|P_j-I| in the same source matrix norm. Only finitely many group-mean arities occur here, at most d! endpoint permutations; choose the minimum of their positive radii. This is an existence proof for a smaller chart of the ALREADY fixed mean, not a numerical a_M or a redefinition of the earlier C_M/C_A. Real outputs are unitary by0.9. All constants/radii are fixed with d,L and this mean, independently of coupling/volume.

For source0.4, each log argument Z is the product of an endpoint path, a straight translated edge path, an inverse endpoint path and an inverse reference coarse path. All four are real unitary and individually within B_len epsilon_f ofI in the above gauge, hence |Z-I|<=4B_len epsilon_f. For source0.12, endpoint group means replace the first and third paths; (2) gives |Z-I|<=6B_len epsilon_f. Thus the single sufficient input tests

 B_len epsilon_f<a_M, 6B_len epsilon_f<1/2              (3)

place both fixed definitions inside their log/mean charts. The principal matrix logarithm satisfies |log Z|<=2|Z-I| when |Z-I|<1/2. Both source formulas have positive path/site weights summing to1. Their averaged logarithm therefore has norm <=12B_len epsilon_f. It is skew-Hermitian for real inputs; consequently |exp X-I|<=|X|. Keeping the reference U(c) on the RIGHT exactly as in0.4/0.12 yields for EACH edge

 |M^1(U)(c)-U(c)|<=12B_len epsilon_f.                 (4)

No norm of a composition has been silently called C_A; both endpoint means and outer log-average-exponential were counted. The same estimate applies to whichever one of0.4/0.12 the fixed physical construction uses, without choosing a favorable version. It does not prove that their values or Hessians coincide off the refinement locus.

The four straight reference edges form the boundary of the actual L by L fine plaquette square in C4. Its holonomy differs fromI by at most L^2 epsilon_f, by the ordered nonabelian surface product. Four-factor unitary telescoping of(4) then proves

 |M^1(U)(dp_coarse)-I|<=(L^2+48B_len)epsilon_f.         (5)

This estimate is covariant under the auxiliary local gauge, so it is the estimate for the original physical field. For the actual ONE local source minimum U1,D satisfying its chi1 good test epsilon_f<=e L^-2, and M^1(U1,D)=V on the required coarse edges, this yields

 |V(dp_coarse)-I|<=K4 e,
 K4=1+48 d A_edge/L.                                 (6)

K4 is deliberately conservative, fixed and explicit. No grade, optimal constant or new physical theorem is attached to it. With the exact refinement identity from1746, (6) supplies a local condition7 consumer on covered new refinement plaquettes, with auxiliary e_var>K4 e. It supplies no K_old for unchanged fine/exterior strata.

ACTUAL SOURCE COVERAGE TEST, WITHOUT CHANGING DOMAINS. Use the ORIGINAL source Gamma layer from1.21 and the original unit-block/coarse partitions. A C4 attached to a coarse plaquette whose substituted supports meet that layer, including all its endpoint paths and fine plaquettes, lies within an extra conservative4dL+4d neighborhood of the link-carrier allowance used in1739. Retain the new sufficient radius

 r4=2d L M1+8dL+8d.

The original small-background test cubes D' have side a=L^2 M2 R1, their four-layer halo contributes8b with b=L M2 R1, and h=L M R1 is the original clearance budget from source construction. The condition

 h>r4+d(a+8b)+8d                                    (7)

puts ONE complete original test cube containing the coarse-loop carrier and its full four-layer halo inside Omega1. More explicitly select a fine vertex on the loop in the original D' partition; (for M2 R1 sufficiently large that a exceeds2L with room for the four halos) all C4 lies in that D' enlarged halo. The extra diameter allowance in(7) puts that entire halo in Omega1. No new partition/test cube or changed determining set is selected. It is still essential to check that this actual D' is in the original P0/P1 small-background class. Containment alone is not substituted for that indicator.

The source-allowed symbolic subfamily from1739 also pays this stronger arithmetic test: d=4, odd L>=13, M1>=1 a source power ofL, M2=L^2M1, M>=L^3M2, R1>=1. Then h>=L^4M2R1, d(a+8b)<=8L^2M2R1, and r4+8d=8LM1+32L+64<=48LM1. Hence the right side of(7) is <=(8L^2+48/L)M2R1, strictly smaller than h. Compatible torus periods, actual maximal domains and old exterior remain required. This is a sufficient subfamily, not an assertion that the fixed physical simultaneous profile has already been instantiated in it.

The new work resolves the two-local-carrier/type mechanisms in1746 by proving a four-corner path-gauge estimate and separately accounting for both actual source mean compositions, conditional on the explicit single-minimum carrier and charts.
